activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: The server log shows activity at 03.00. An automated process must have been running.
cards.explanation: El registro es evidencia fuerte de una actividad en curso; «must have been running» encaja.

cards.statement: She must has forgotten the appointment.
cards.explanation: Después del modal usamos «have», no «has»: «must have forgotten».

cards.statement: The signature is completely different. Maya can't have signed this form.
cards.explanation: La firma distinta permite descartar que Maya firmara el documento.

cards.statement: They only started ten minutes ago, so they can't have finished already.
cards.explanation: El poco tiempo transcurrido permite descartar que hayan terminado: «can't have finished».

cards.statement: Jon was abroad all week, so he must have attended Tuesday's local meeting.
cards.explanation: La evidencia descarta la asistencia; debe decir «can't have attended».

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 6 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Her coat is still here, so she must have left the building.
cards.explanation: El abrigo sugiere que sigue dentro; la conclusión natural es «can't have left».

cards.statement: He looks exhausted. He must have been working all night.
cards.explanation: El aspecto cansado apoya la deducción sobre una actividad prolongada: «must have been working».

cards.statement: The road was blocked. They may have taken a different route.
cards.explanation: La ruta alternativa es una posibilidad compatible con la carretera bloqueada.

cards.statement: No one heard the alarm. It could have been switched off before the incident.
cards.explanation: La pasiva modal presenta una explicación posible para que nadie oyera la alarma.

cards.statement: The sample was contaminated; the lid might not have been fitted properly.
cards.explanation: Una tapa mal colocada es una causa posible; la pasiva negativa está bien formada.

cards.statement: The figures are inconsistent. Someone could have entered one of them incorrectly.
cards.explanation: Una entrada incorrecta es una explicación posible de la inconsistencia.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Nora isn't answering. She might have left her phone at home.
cards.explanation: El teléfono olvidado es una explicación posible, no segura; «might have» es adecuado.

cards.statement: The lights are off and the door is locked. They must have gone home.
cards.explanation: Dos indicios apoyan una deducción fuerte: «must have gone».

cards.statement: The door shows no damage, so the intruder might have used a key.
cards.explanation: La falta de daños hace posible, pero no segura, la explicación de una llave.

cards.statement: The archive was sealed until Friday, so the document can't have been removed on Thursday.
cards.explanation: El archivo sellado descarta la retirada; la pasiva «can't have been removed» es precisa.

cards.statement: They only started ten minutes ago, so they mustn't have finished already.
cards.explanation: Para una deducción negativa fuerte usamos «can't have», no «mustn't have».

cards.statement: The email could have gone to your spam folder; check there first.
cards.explanation: «Could have gone» ofrece una explicación posible y usa el participio correcto «gone».

cards.statement: The ground is soaked. It must have rained overnight.
cards.explanation: El suelo mojado es evidencia fuerte; «must have rained» expresa una conclusión lógica.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.
